RISK MITIGATION FRAMEWORK:

IDENTIFIED RISK RESPONSE STRATEGIES:
- Technical debt accumulation: Scheduled refactoring sprints
- Scope creep: Change control board with stakeholder representation
- Resource constraints: Flexible resource pooling across projects
- Technology obsolescence: Regular technology refresh cycles

ESCALATION PROCEDURES:
LEVEL 1: Team-level resolution (within 24 hours)
LEVEL 2: Project Manager intervention (within 4 hours)
LEVEL 3: Executive stakeholder involvement (immediate)
LEVEL 4: Full project reassessment (critical situations)

CONTINGENCY PLANNING:
- Backup resource identification
- Alternative technology approaches
- Scope reduction options
- Timeline extension protocols

DISASTER RECOVERY:
- Automated backup and restore procedures
- Geographic redundancy planning
- Business continuity protocols
- Communication plans for outage scenarios
